title: 第六章 难道是他？

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    顺声观望，三层门口处，一位发须皆白的老者，正盯着自己。
楚枫知道，这位是看守武技阁的守阁长老，别看他年纪近百，但守阁长老的实力，可都是很强的。
“多谢前辈提醒，晚辈自有分寸。”楚枫对其客气的行礼之后，便走了进去。
“哎，又是一个自大的弟子。”守阁长老失望的摇了摇头。
如同楚枫这样的弟子他见多了，可是大多都以失败告终，轻的迷途知返，重的走火入魔，断送大好前程。
可就算如此，长老每当看到新面孔来此后，都会善意的提醒一句，以避免更多弟子步入歧途。
楚枫在三层转了一圈，很快便选择一本中意的武技，拿到那位长老面前做起登记。
“你确定要修炼这本虚幻掌？”守阁长老疑惑的看着楚枫。
“嗯。”楚枫笑着点了点头。
“你有没有看过这本武技的介绍？”守阁长老继续问道。
“回长老，弟子看过了。”楚枫再次笑了笑。
“那你还选择它？这可是整个武技阁，最难修炼的一本。”长老表示不解。
“回长老，这正是弟子想修炼的。”楚枫脸上始终挂着微笑，但目光却异常坚定。
“哎，现在的年轻人，真是不知天高地厚。”守阁长老，还是为楚枫做了登记，只是当楚枫离开后，他却摇了摇头。
这虚幻掌有多难，守阁长老最清楚，当初的他耗费大量时间修炼，都未曾成功。
楚枫年龄比他当初小，修为比他当初弱，在他看来，楚枫绝不可能修炼成功。
“嗯？”
忽然，楚枫一愣，一道熟悉的身影却与他擦肩而过，竟是段宇轩，并且他的脸色很是难看。
楚枫与他不熟，所以并未多想，但就在他准备离开时，身后却传来窃窃私语，而他也得到了段宇轩郁闷的原因。
“那不是段宇轩么，他不是已有四段武技，怎么还来这里挑选武技？难道说四段武技，在杨天雨那里？”

“你还不知道么？昨晚盛宴之时，内门长老提醒他们两个，四段武技不可共享，只能一人修炼，并且要早日归还。”
“听长老这么一说，他们两人都傻了，最终当着众人澄清，原来他们根本不是考核的第一名，那击杀了四十只凶兽的另有其人。”
“竟然还有这种事，那他们两个开始为什么要承认？”
“哎，这谁知道呢，也许是碍于面子呗，不过这次他们两个可是丢人丢到家了。”
“的确，不过那第一究竟是谁？外门好像没听过有这么厉害的人吧？”
“四十只凶兽啊，其中还有一只四阶凶兽，真是不敢想象，那人究竟是多凶悍？”
听着这些，楚枫笑着摇了摇头，便向楼上走去，迫不及待的想要开始修炼。
四层如同一层一样，同样是热闹非凡，由于新弟子大多还在挑选武技，这里的可都是老弟子。
一眼望去，与其说是一个楼层，更不如说是个演武场，足有上千人在对着机关庄修炼，喊杀声响彻一片，颇为壮观。
但喜欢安静的，也可以选择一个密室独自修炼，当石门关闭之后，隔绝一切干扰。
楚枫并未加入他们，而是前往了第六层，这里则与第三层一样，相对安静许多，修炼的位子也就多了许多。
楚枫走进了一间密室，石门关闭后，他先是对着机关桩鞠了一躬，因为他知道，接下来，这只机关桩，将饱受他的摧残。
机关桩由玄铁木打造而成，极为坚固，只要向它发动攻击，它就会自动闪避。
并且闪避的速度，会根据对方的出招速度而变，除非武技修炼大成，否则很难伤到它，乃是修炼武技的最佳器具。
“虚幻掌，以掌风发力，制敌于无形。”
楚枫再次看了一遍虚幻掌的修炼方法，这才来到机关桩面前。
唰唰——
他突然出手，只见双掌化作两道虚影，对着机关桩的两个点，拍打而去。
嗖嗖——
可就在即将击中的一霎那，那机关桩左右一晃，竟闪电般的躲开了楚枫的攻击。

见状，楚枫不由笑道：“有点意思。”
自此日起，楚枫除了吃饭睡觉，日日都会待在这武技阁，不停的修炼。
雷霆三式，由青龙宗开宗祖师所创，虽然玄妙至极，但修炼难度非常之高。
而虚幻掌，之所以会被守阁长老称为，武技阁最难修炼的武技，那也不是没有原因的。
不过经过一段时间的修炼，楚枫已是渐渐了解两种武技的特性。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Looking around, at the door on the third floor, an old man with white hair and beard is staring at him.
Chu Feng knew that this was the elder who was guarding the Martial Arts Pavilion. Even though he was nearly a hundred years old, the elders who were guarding the pavilion were very strong.
"Thank you, senior, for reminding me. This junior has his own sense of propriety." After Chu Feng politely saluted him, he walked in.
"Hey, another arrogant disciple." Elder Shuge shook his head in disappointment.
He has seen many disciples like Chu Feng, but most of them ended in failure. They either lost their way and turned back, or they went crazy and ruined their great future.
But even so, whenever the elder sees a new face coming, he will give a kind reminder to prevent more disciples from going astray.
Chu Feng walked around the third floor and quickly selected a book of martial arts that he liked and took it to the elder to register.
"Are you sure you want to practice this Illusory Palm?" Elder Shouge looked at Chu Feng doubtfully.
"Yes." Chu Feng smiled and nodded.
"Have you read the introduction to this martial arts book?" Elder Shouge continued to ask.
"Go back to the elders. Disciple has seen it." Chu Feng smiled again.
"Then you still choose it? This is the most difficult book to practice in the entire martial arts pavilion." The elder expressed confusion.
"Back to the elder, this is exactly what this disciple wants to practice." Chu Feng always had a smile on his face, but his eyes were extremely firm.
"Hey, today's young people really don't know how high the sky is." The elder guarding the pavilion still registered Chu Feng, but when Chu Feng left, he shook his head.
Elder Guarding the Pavilion knows how difficult this illusory palm is. He spent a lot of time practicing it but never succeeded.
Chu Feng was younger than him before, and his cultivation was weaker than before. In his opinion, Chu Feng would never be able to succeed in cultivation.
"Huh?"
Suddenly, Chu Feng was stunned. A familiar figure passed him by. It was Duan Yuxuan, and his expression was very ugly.
Chu Feng was not familiar with him, so he didn't think much about it, but just when he was about to leave, whispers came from behind him, and he also got the reason for Duan Yuxuan's depression.
"Isn't that Duan Yuxuan? Doesn't he already have four levels of martial arts? Why is he still here to choose martial arts? Could it be that the fourth level of martial arts is at Yang Tianyu's place?"
"Don't you know yet? During the feast last night, the inner sect elders reminded the two of them that the four levels of martial arts cannot be shared and can only be practiced by one person, and they must return them as soon as possible."
"When the elder said this, both of them were dumbfounded. In the end, they clarified in front of everyone that they were not the first in the assessment at all. There was someone else who killed forty ferocious beasts."
"There is such a thing, so why did the two of them admit it in the first place?"
"Hey, who knows, maybe it's because of face, but this time the two of them are really embarrassed."
"Indeed, but who is the number one? It seems that the outer sect has never heard of such a powerful person, right?"
"Forty ferocious beasts, including a fourth-level ferocious beast. I really can't imagine how ferocious that person is?"
After hearing this, Chu Feng smiled and shook his head, then walked upstairs, eager to start practicing.
The fourth floor is just like the first floor, and it is also very lively. Since most of the new disciples are still choosing their martial arts, the people here are all old disciples.
At a glance, it was more like a martial arts arena than a floor. There were thousands of people practicing in front of the machine village, and the shouts of killing could be heard everywhere, which was quite spectacular.
But if you like peace and quiet, you can also choose a secret room to practice alone. When the stone door is closed, all interference will be isolated.
Chu Feng did not join them, but went to the sixth floor. Like the third floor, it was relatively quiet and there were many more places for cultivation.
Chu Feng walked into a secret room. After the stone door was closed, he first bowed to the machine pile, becauseBecause he knew that next, this machine pile would be tortured by him.
The trap pile is made of dark iron wood and is extremely strong. As long as you launch an attack against it, it will automatically dodge.
Moreover, the speed of dodge will change according to the speed of the opponent's moves. Unless you have mastered martial arts, it will be difficult to hurt it. It is the best tool for practicing martial arts.
"Illusory Palm uses the wind of the palm to exert force to control the enemy invisible."
Chu Feng looked at the practice method of Illusory Palm again, and then came to the machine pile.
Swish--
He suddenly took action, and his palms turned into two phantoms, slapping away at the two points of the machine pile.
Whoosh——
But at the moment when it was about to hit, the machine pole swayed from side to side and dodged Chu Feng's attack like lightning.
Seeing this, Chu Feng couldn't help but smile and said: "It's a bit interesting."
From that day on, apart from eating and sleeping, Chu Feng would stay in this martial arts pavilion every day and practice non-stop.
The Three Thunder Styles were created by the founder of the Qinglong Sect. Although they are extremely mysterious, they are very difficult to practice.
There is a reason why Illusory Palm is called the most difficult martial skill to practice in the Martial Arts Pavilion by the elders guarding the Pavilion.
However, after a period of practice, Chu Feng gradually understood the characteristics of the two martial arts.
